text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle remains fast asleep. After 
hearing about her feelings from the 
Trainer, Daiichi Ruby decides to hold a 
press conference.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wake K.S.Miracle up and bring her to the 
press conference. Entrusted with this task 
by Daiichi Ruby, the Umamusume carry 
K.S.Miracle, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Soon her stamina runs out. Carrying her 
feelings, her Trainer takes KS Miracle on 
their back and desperately calls out to 
her as they head to the press conference.
